# Francisco Guadarrama

> Personal academic and professional website of Francisco Guadarrama, a physician working in medical oncology, health systems, access to cancer treatment, and high-value care under resource constraints.

Canonical: https://fguadarrama.com/
Languages: English and Spanish
Author: Francisco Guadarrama

## Main sections

- Home: https://fguadarrama.com/
- Experience: professional and clinical experience is contained in the Experience section of the homepage.
- Education: medical and postgraduate training is contained in the Education section of the homepage.
- Selected Publications: selected scholarly work with DOI links is contained in the Publications section of the homepage.
- Contact: LinkedIn and the site's contact form are contained in the Contact section of the homepage.
